name: pgAdmin 4 v9.19 with PostgreSQL 18
description: PostgreSQL admin web UI with login, plus a ready Postgres 18 database.

PORT.description: Port pgAdmin listens on (Railway routes the public domain and healthcheck here).

PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL.description: Required. Your login e-mail for the pgAdmin admin account (used on the first start only).

PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, 8-128 characters (generated). Used on the first start, or with PGADMIN_RESET_ADMIN=true.

PGADMIN_RESET_ADMIN.description: true = at the next start, set the admin password from PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD and unlock the account. Set back to false afterwards.

PRELOAD_PG_NAME.description: Name of the pre-registered server in the pgAdmin tree (first start only).

PRELOAD_PG_HOST.description: Postgres host pre-registered on the first start. Empty = no pre-registered server.

PRELOAD_PG_DB.description: Maintenance database of the pre-registered Postgres.

PRELOAD_PG_PASSWORD.description: Password of the pre-registered Postgres (written to a .pgpass file in pgAdmin's storage, refreshed at every start).

PRELOAD_PG_SSLMODE.description: libpq sslmode for the pre-registered server (disable, prefer, require, ...).

PGADMIN_CONFIG_MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS.description: Failed logins before an account is locked (unlock with PGADMIN_RESET_ADMIN=true).

PGADMIN_CONFIG_UPGRADE_CHECK_ENABLED.description: pgAdmin's online upgrade check (False: no calls to pgadmin.org).

PGADMIN_CONFIG_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Send the session cookie over HTTPS only (Railway domains are HTTPS).

PGADMIN_DISABLE_POSTFIX.description: Do not start the image's local Postfix (Railway blocks SMTP below Pro).

GUNICORN_THREADS.description: Request threads in pgAdmin's single gunicorn worker.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGUSER.description: User for the Railway Data panel.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Railway Data panel.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Railway Data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when the image first starts.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection URL for other services in this project.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser created when the image first starts.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to shut down cleanly.
